svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 05 · Los Angeles · 08/12 Jacaranda Season (Common)
svg.desc: In late spring the trees go purple, and so do the sidewalks, and so do your bike tires. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
